t: The $(item)GPS Area Tool/$ is an advanced version of the $(l:tools/gps_tool)GPS Tool/$, which can store $(italic)two/$ coordinates in the world. $(thing)Right-click/$ a block to change the first coordinate ($(#f00)P1/$), and $(thing)left-click/$ for the second coordinate ($(#0f0)P2/$).$(p)You can quickly adjust coordinates by scrolling the mouse wheel while sneaking; the coordinate changed will be the last one you clicked.
$(item)GPS 范围工具/$是$(l:tools/gps_tool)GPS 工具/$的高级版本，可以在世界中保存$(italic)两个/$坐标。$(thing)右键点击/$方块可更改第一个坐标（$(#f00)P1/$），而$(thing)左键点击/$则用于第二个坐标（$(#0f0)P2/$）。$(p)你也可以在潜行时滚动鼠标滚轮来快速调整坐标；被修改的会是你最后一次点击的那个坐标。

Sneaking and right- or left-clicking air will note the 'active' coordinate without storing it; this is the coordinate adjusted by scrolling the mouse wheel.$(p)By $(thing)right/$ or $(thing)left-clicking/$ in the air, you can open a GUI to enter precise block coordinates; click the $(#f00)P1/$ or $(#0f0)P2/$ button as appropriate.$(p)In the GUI, you can also change the $(thing)Area type/$ for the tool, allowing you to preview the area in different configurations.
潜行时对空气右键或左键，可以将对应坐标设为“活动”坐标而不进行保存；这就是滚动鼠标滚轮时会被调整的那个坐标。$(p)对空气执行$(thing)右键/$或$(thing)左键点击/$时，你可以打开一个 GUI 来输入精确的方块坐标；根据需要点击$(#f00)P1/$或$(#0f0)P2/$按钮。$(p)在该 GUI 中，你还可以更改此工具的$(thing)范围类型/$，从而以不同配置预览该范围。

The $(item)GPS Area Tool/$ supports $(l:programming/variables#global)Global Variables/$ like the basic $(l:tools/gps_tool#variables)GPS Tool/$ does, but of course, $(italic)two/$ variables may be used.$(p)In a $(l:programming/programmer)Programmer/$, $(thing)left-click/$ the programming area background with the $(item)GPS Area Tool/$ to create a new $(l:programming/area)Area/$ puzzle piece, or $(thing)left-click/$ on an existing $(l:programming/area)Area/$ puzzle piece to update it with this tool's settings.

$(item)GPS 范围工具/$和基础版的$(l:tools/gps_tool#variables)GPS 工具/$一样支持$(l:programming/variables#global)全局变量/$，不过当然，你可以使用$(italic)两个/$变量。$(p)在$(l:programming/programmer)程序编写器/$中，手持$(item)GPS 范围工具/$对编程区域背景执行$(thing)左键点击/$，即可创建一个新的$(l:programming/area)范围/$拼图块；或者对现有的$(l:programming/area)范围/$拼图块执行$(thing)左键点击/$，就能用该工具当前的设置更新它。
